canonical_statement: For topological measurable spaces alpha and beta with measurable opens on alpha and the Borel sigma algebra on beta, every continuous f : alpha -> beta sends any filter-convergent family of probability measures mu_n -> mu in the weak topology to the weakly convergent family of pushforwards f_* mu_n -> f_* mu.
domain_and_universes: alpha : Type u, beta : Type v, arbitrary index iota : Type w and filter L; probability measures use mathlib's ProbabilityMeasure weak topology
conclusion: Tendsto (fun n => ProbabilityMeasure.map (mu_n n) hf.measurable.aemeasurable) L (nhds (ProbabilityMeasure.map mu hf.measurable.aemeasurable))
representation_notes: ProbabilityMeasure packages probability mass and its topology is mathlib's weak-convergence topology. Continuity yields the AEMeasurable witnesses required by ProbabilityMeasure.map. No sequence-only or random-variable restatement replaces the general filtered measure root.
